description: Returns whether a domain is in CrawlCheck's registry and which agent files it serves: the llms and agents files, a media kit, a tested entity graph, an AI access policy and agent-callable surfaces. With no domain, returns counts per shelf. Rows come from fetching llms.txt, agents.md and the rest, never from self-reports or payment. For what those surfaces actually do use list_verified_capabilities.

domain.description: A bare domain. Omit for the corpus-wide shelf counts.

shelf.description: Filter the list to one shelf: llms, agents, mediakit, entity, aipolicy, agentapi

name: registry_lookup
title: Registry lookup
